idea-plugin.name: Secrets Leak Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Secrets Leak Detector scans your files and flags hardcoded secrets — API keys, tokens, and private keys — directly in the editor, before they end up in a commit.

What it detects

  • AWS access and secret keys
  • GitHub personal access tokens
  • Slack tokens
  • Google Cloud API keys and service account private keys
  • Stripe live secret/restricted keys
  • JSON Web Tokens (JWT)
  • Database connection strings with a plaintext password (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • RSA/EC/OpenSSH private keys
  • Generic API keys and access tokens, using keyword matching and entropy analysis

The inspection runs on all text files, not just source code — so secrets hiding in .env, .yml, .properties, and other config files are caught too.

One-click fix

Each detected secret comes with a quick fix (Alt+Enter) to instantly redact it with a placeholder value.

Low noise

Placeholder values, repeated-character strings, and low-entropy matches are filtered out, and files under node_modules, build, .git, and other VCS-ignored paths are skipped.
